row.scim_price_text: Free (travel); Expense $15/user/mo after the first 5 expensing users
row.team_price_text: Free (travel, up to 300 employees); Expense $15/user/mo after the first 5 expensing users
row.evidence: Navan's integrations page offers an 'Okta SCIM integration' to 'Automate user provisioning' and says most native integrations are included 'with no additional fees from Navan'; the help centre documents SCIM with Okta and Microsoft Entra.
row.notes: New row. Navan (formerly TripActions) is free for travel on Navan Business (companies up to 300 employees); Navan Expense is free for 5 monthly expensing users, then $15/user/mo; Navan Enterprise is quote-only and, per the pricing FAQ, adds support rather than features. No page ties SCIM or SAML/OIDC SSO to a plan, so both are recorded on Navan Business (confidence medium). SCIM via the Okta OIN app (Create/Update/Deactivate; needs Okta Lifecycle Management) and via Entra set up by the Navan account manager (Microsoft's gallery tutorial covers only SAML + JIT). The SCIM endpoint and schema are not published. The public Expense API (OAuth client credentials) has no user endpoints. Per-user prices left null because Navan Business is free for travel and expense is billed per monthly active expensing user. idp.entra is via_generic because Navan supports Entra over SCIM outside the gallery app; generic is false because no endpoint is published.

plans.name: Navan Business
plans.price_text: Free (travel, companies up to 300 employees); Navan Expense free for the first 5 monthly expensing users, then $15 per user per month
plans.notes: Pricing page does not list SSO or SCIM per tier. SCIM is one of Navan's HRIS integrations ('30+ seamless HRIS integrations' on the Business card), and the integrations FAQ says most native integrations carry no additional Navan fee.

plans.name: Navan Enterprise
plans.price_text: Let's talk / Get a price quote
plans.notes: Pricing FAQ says both plans have all travel and expense features; Enterprise adds implementation and scaling support.

auth.token_source: Navan Admin > Configuration > Integrations > HR Integrations > SCIM > Create token
auth.notes: In Okta's Enable API Integration flow the admin signs in with an email address plus the Navan SCIM token (entered as the 'Generated Password').

endpoints.notes: No SCIM endpoint list or base URL is published.

operations.notes: Help centre: 'Add new users', 'Disable terminated users', 'Update employee profiles'. PUT vs PATCH not documented. Group push not documented (Okta OIN does not tick Group Push).

deprovision.data_retained: Company keeps all booking data for the deactivated user
deprovision.notes: SCIM deactivation disables the Navan user; the user-management article says deactivated users immediately lose access.

custom.how: Navan-specific attributes (travelPolicy, travelerApprover, companyOffice, region, division) are created in Okta under the urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:enterprise:2.0:User namespace

attributes.notes: From the Okta field-mapping table: employeeNumber maps to Employee ID, division maps to Subsidiary, manager and travelerApprover must be email strings, companyOffice must match the Navan office name 1:1.

limitations.text: Okta SCIM requires the customer to subscribe to Okta Lifecycle Management.
Entra SCIM is not self-serve: the Navan account manager sets it up.
Once an HRIS/SCIM sync is enabled, manual edits to the user list are overridden by the daily sync when they differ.

scim.notes: SCIM is documented only as an Okta OIN integration (self-serve token) and a Microsoft Entra integration set up by the Navan account manager. Navan does not publish the SCIM base URL, schema or endpoint reference.

audit_log_api.notes: Audit logs (beta for some customers) are viewed and exported in the admin UI; no audit-log API is documented.

user_api.notes: The public Navan Expense API covers transactions, receipts, GL codes, tax mappings and custom fields; it has no user, group or role endpoints. A Booking API and an MCP server also exist. No documented user-management API.

okta.notes: OIN page ticks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate; Group Push, Sync Password and Schema Discovery are not ticked. built_by vendor: Navan's help centre documents the OIN app's provisioning setup.

entra.notes: Microsoft's gallery tutorial covers SAML SSO with JIT only. Navan says it supports an Entra SCIM integration that the account manager sets up (not via the gallery app).

google.notes: Navan's Google SSO guide uses a custom SAML app ('Setup my own custom app'), not a catalogue app.

onelogin.notes: Navan lists OneLogin as an SSO integration; no provisioning documented. OneLogin catalogue page not checked (blocks bots).

fallbacks.other_sync: HRIS integrations (HiBob, BambooHR, Workday, Rippling, Gusto, Personio and others) and a daily HR-SFTP user file
fallbacks.notes: Bulk add/remove/edit by uploading an .xlsx user list, with an option to disable users missing from the file.
